disclaimer: Dynamic-topology approximations only: time-expanded TTL<=arrival assumes unit-rate tail decay and ignores later food growth, future boosts, newly laid body segments, and opponent reactions; it is not exact future reachability. Diagnostic T-arm input only; authorizes no serving obs-spec change.
name: dynamic-topology approximations

orientation.board_planes: Canonical arena-aligned lattice (y in [0, grid_h), x in [0, grid_w)), +x Right/East, +y Down/South; hero head uniquely marked at own_ttl == 1.0.

channels.name: wall_occupancy
channels.rule: 1.0 (65535) if occupied by any living snake segment, 0.0 (0) if free; conv pads exterior border with 1.0 (wall).

channels.name: own_ttl
channels.rule: clamp(own_ttl_steps(y, x) / max(1, hero_length), 0.0, 1.0) where own_ttl_steps = max(0, hero_length - hero_seg_count) + (hero_seg_count - k); hero head has 1.0 (65535), empty 0.0.

channels.name: enemy_ttl
channels.rule: clamp(max_{s in 1..5 alive} enemy_ttl_steps(s, y, x) / 1000.0, 0.0, 1.0), empty 0.0.

summaries.boost_treatment_3_5: If hero not alive or hero_length < min_boost_length, missing-value sentinel = -1.0. Else step d=1 traverses c1 = head + dir(a) and c2 = head + 2*dir(a), popping pop1 = 2 + 1[boost_frames + 1 >= boost_length_cost_frames and hero_length > 1] own tail segments and 1 enemy tail segment. If c1 or c2 is out-of-bounds, enemy_ttl > 1, or own_ttl > pop1, value = 0.0. Else time-expanded BFS from (c2, d=1) up to d <= 128 with remaining own_ttl shifted by -(pop1 - 1).
summaries.normal_actions_0_2: Step d=1 to c1 = head + dir(a). If c1 out-of-bounds or total_ttl(c1) > 1, value = 0.0. Else 4-neighbor time-expanded BFS from (c1, d=1) up to d <= 128 admitting neighbor u at step d iff in-bounds and max(own_ttl(u), enemy_ttl(u)) <= d.
